purpose: Compile the exact L13H8 semantic-opener source token position together with the v9 pending-closer read, so bracket internal interventions no longer require an externally supplied recipient closer or source position.

predictions.pred_a_v9_and_authority_bound: All authority hashes hold and v9 remains a release.
predictions.pred_b_exact_recipient_state: Infer the labeled recipient closer on every one of 2,088 endpoints.
predictions.pred_c_exact_l13h8_source_position: Select the same last semantic opener token used by the causal L13H8 executors on every endpoint.
predictions.pred_d_strict_token_rejection: Reject non-list, noninteger, missing-opener, and raw/token recipient mismatch inputs.
predictions.pred_e_dependency_and_price: Zero learned scalars, fits, and model calls; remove recipient closer and semantic source position while retaining raw text, native token IDs, desired edit, and native model execution required by the intervention program.

terminal.invalid: Any authority, exact-selection, rejection, or scope check fails.
